cohort: Mothers and neonates whose delivery statistics were recorded on a hospital database in a large tertiary referral center in Dublin between January 1 and July 31, 2020.
finding: The study found no evidence of a negative impact of the Covid-19 pandemic on maternity services, as demonstrated by maternal and neonatal outcomes, with a significantly lower rate of preterm birth in January-July 2020 compared to the same period in 2018/2019.
cross-section timing: Maternity statistics from January 1 to July 31, 2020, were compared to the same months in 2018 and 2019.
